verdict.rationale: Discord documents first-class bots and apps that run inside servers. Developers authenticate them with bot tokens, they can receive server events over the Gateway WebSocket, and users can find and add them through the App Directory, so an agent-backed bot can sit in a channel. The pack does not show mention-triggered participation or any native AI-agent capability, so the AI behaviour must be built by the developer. Missing for 10: documented mention-triggered message events and replies, first-party AI agent support, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent bots participating in channel conversations.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned
